profile.constituencyprofile_Text: Narsipatnam Assembly Constituency, located in Anakapalli district of Andhra Pradesh, comprises four mandals—Narsipatnam, Makavarapalem, Golugonda, and Nathavaram—with Narsipatnam serving as the administrative headquarters. The constituency plays a vital role in the district’s political and administrative landscape. A major landmark is the Sri Raja Sagi Suryanarayana Raju Thandava Reservoir Project, constructed across the Thandava River between 1965 and 1975 near G.K. Gudem village, about 28 km from Narsipatnam. Covering over 51,000 acres under irrigation, it is now being upgraded through a ₹500 crore project linking it to the Yeleru canal. Alongside irrigation, the reservoir also draws visitors as an eco-tourism spot. Other attractions include the Sarugudu Waterfalls, a 30-foot perennial cascade in the Eastern Ghats near Nathavaram, and the historic Brahma Lingeswara Swami Temple, situated 3 km from Narsipatnam on the Varaha River. Believed to be built by Lord Brahma, this ancient Shiva temple is rich in mythology, recognized as a protected archaeological site, and draws thousands of devotees during Karthika Masam and Shivaratri. With strong irrigation facilities, cultural heritage, and natural attractions, Narsipatnam is well positioned for industrial growth, religious tourism, and cultural preservation, targeting an annual growth rate of 15% across key sectors.
profile.geography: Narsipatnam Assembly Constituency spans 899.18 sq. km, bordered by Chodavaram, Anakapalli, Yelamanchili, Payakaraopeta, Kakinada, and Alluri Sitarama Raju districts. The region features fertile alluvial and black cotton soils in Nathavaram and Golugonda, and red sandy soils in Narsipatnam and Makavarapalem, suitable for dry crops. Irrigation covers 15,568 hectares, with Nathavaram and Makavarapalem leading in major and minor irrigation. The subtropical climate shows high rainfall variability, with a 37.4% deficit in Kharif 2024 and a 42.6% surplus in Rabi 2024, significantly influencing agriculture and water management.
profile.populationDesc: Narsipatnam has a total population of 2,66,639, comprising 1,07,865 males and 1,11,004 females with 82.5% residing in rural areas and 17.5% in urban areas. The constituency has 72467 households, with a sex ratio of 1,024 females per 1,000 males. The literacy rate stands at 57.89%, indicating steady progress in education levels. The workforce is primarily engaged in agriculture, industries, and services.
profile.administrationDesc: Narsipatnam Assembly Constituency consists of four mandals—Narsipatnam, Makavarapalem, Golugonda, and Nathavaram. It also includes the Narsipatnam Municipality, which serves as the administrative and urban center of the constituency.
profile.educationHealthcareDesc: Narsipatnam Assembly Constituency has emerged as a key educational and healthcare hub in the Anakapalli district. Education is strengthened through 229 schools, 83 smart classrooms, and skill development initiatives that have trained over 10,000 youth under NSDC and PMKVY programs. The healthcare system is robust, featuring 1 Area Hospital, 9 Primary Health Centers, 3 Urban PHCs, 1 AYUSH Hospital, and 78 Sub-centers, ensuring wide coverage. Emergency medical services are supported by 6 Fixed Day Health Services vehicles and 4 ambulances under the 108 service, providing timely healthcare access and critical response to the diverse needs of the population.
profile.culturalheritageDesc: Narsipatnam Constituency is rich in cultural and historical landmarks. The Sri Brahma Lingeswara Swamy Temple at Balighattam is an ancient shrine of Lord Shiva, famed for its 108 intricately carved pillars, mandapas, and ornate gopuram. The region also hosts natural attractions like Daramattam Waterfall, Sarugudu Waterfalls, and reservoirs at Ravanapalli and Thandava, combining spirituality, eco-tourism, and irrigation significance. Sarugudu Waterfalls, flowing year-round, are particularly sacred during Karthika Masam, with a nearby Shiva temple adding to its spiritual value. Another key site is the Alluri Sitarama Raju Memorial Park at Krishnadevipeta, Golugonda mandal, dedicated to the freedom fighter’s heroic role in the Rampa Rebellion, featuring his statue and landscaped gardens.

economy_text.economy_Text:
Narsipatnam Constituency, with a Gross Constituency Domestic Product (GCDP) of ₹5,185 crores in 2023-24 (FRE), is poised for significant growth, projected to reach ₹9,678 crores by 2028-29, driven by a sustainable annual growth rate of 12-15%. The Economic Vision Plan focuses on harnessing sectoral strengths, improving infrastructure, fostering industrial diversification, and enhancing employment opportunities to establish Narsipatnam as a vibrant, investment-friendly economic hub

Sector-Wise Economic Overview 

  • Services Sector: Valued at ₹1,960 crores (2023-24) with a growth rate of 21.50%, expected to reach ₹3,786 crores by 2028-29.

  • Industries Sector: Contributes ₹977 crores (2023-24) with a growth rate of 21.51%, projected to grow to ₹1,888 crores by 2028-29.

  • Agricultural & Allied Sector: Stands at ₹1,860 crores (2023-24) with a growth rate of 18.53%, anticipated to reach ₹3,337 crores by 2028-29.
economy_text.gcdP_Growth_Text: Narsipatnam Constituency is witnessing strong economic momentum, aiming for a steady 15% annual GCDP growth across its primary sectors: agriculture, industry, and services. This forward-thinking strategy aligns with the vision of transforming Narsipatnam into a vibrant economic center by 2047, promoting sustainable progress, employment opportunities, and inclusive prosperity.
